name: MMoCA Teen Forum
what_you_do: Learn how an art exhibition is made, create and run educational programs, and meet museum and arts professionals through job shadows.
who_can_apply: 11th and 12th grade students from the Madison area who care about the arts.
pay_detail: Members are paid a stipend. The amount is not stated.
duration: 6 to 8 hours per month, in person at MMoCA, through the year
deadline_text: The page says applications were closed for the 2025 Teen Forum. No 2026-27 dates are posted.
how_to_apply: Not described on the page. Call MMoCA at (608) 257-0158 to ask when the next application opens.
notes: The page may be out of date (it mentions the 2025 group), so confirm by phone before planning around it. Small group.
